component.name: Vitro
component.summary: The glass terminal — fish-first, with the nlt brain a keypress away

description.p: Vitro is a fish-first terminal made of dark glass: real terminal emulation via GTK3+VTE (the same engine as GNOME Terminal), a kitty-dark palette, real transparency, and pill tabs that inherit each tab's working directory.
It greets you with ourfetch — its own typed-fast system fetch drawn with every distro's real logo — and the nlt chat sidecar is one keypress away (F1) when nlt is installed.

ul.li: fish (--login) in every tab, so fish integrations just work; falls back to $SHELL
ourfetch greeting in the first tab, with your own image as the logo if you like
Real transparency with a live slider (chrome and cells), pair with Hyprland/KWin blur for frosted glass
Splits: side-by-side and stacked, cycle with Alt+Arrow, panes collapse on exit
New tabs inherit the focused tab's directory
Glass and Graphite themes, 10 000-line scrollback, silent bell, Alt+1..9 jumps

description.p: The nlt sidecar needs nlt installed on the host; the glass terminal works fine without it.

screenshot.caption: Vitro — fish-first terminal with ourfetch greeting and pill tabs

description.p: The Flathub release: real fish (--login) in every tab inside the sandbox — your host ~/.config/fish loads as usual — and the nlt brain (the pattern rescue + chat toolbox) ships inside, so ctrl-g and the F1 sidecar just work.
The flying bar — own fetch introduction, cleaner header, sharper edges everywhere.
Every OS gets its real fastfetch logo — the distro collection is inside.
Run any command like every terminal.
Real fastfetch logos, token colors, staged animation.
